security.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
security.summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.
